caseName: The 100 kN booster chamber handed over by the propulsion hub, taken through heat load, cooling closure and the film cooling that makes it possible
linkedCaseNote: Every geometry and flow rate below is an output of propulsion/codeInterface.py at its design point, an area ratio of 20.35. They are restated here rather than imported so this example runs standalone, and a cross-domain test asserts they still match.

inherited._comment: From the propulsion hub worked example. hubHeatLoadPlaceholder is what the hub computed from its stated placeholder and is carried here specifically so the replacement is visible.

wall._comment: A copper alloy liner is the only realistic choice at this flux. The gas-side temperature is an input rather than an output because Bartz is implicit in it, and 800 K is the GRCop-42 limit.

film._comment: Effectiveness is the fraction of wall heat load removed per unit film fraction. Four is a representative figure for a hydrocarbon film on a copper wall and it is an ASSUMPTION, not a sourced value. The trade below moves with it, and it is registered as unvalidated.

injector._comment: An unlike impinging doublet core, which is the workhorse and is not wall tolerant. The outer row would be a different element, which is why the film fraction exists at all.

stability._comment: Six blades cover tangential modes to third order and do nothing to radial ones, which is the point the stability stage makes.

validation._comment: The measured throat heat flux band from the open literature, used to bound the Bartz result. See validation/referenceCases.py, THROAT_HEAT_FLUX. It is a bound and not a validation.
